summary: Nevada County lookout near Grass Valley: 1921 tree-platform start, 1947 timber tower, 2013 vandal closure, 2015 volunteer reopening; NHLR-registered 2019.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief's record gives 1921 as the build year. NHLR gives 1921 for the first crow's nest platform, 1926 for a wooden tower and 1947 for the current timber tower, and its build field also lists 1981. The story dates each structure separately.

NHLR describes the current tower as a 108-foot timber L-4 tower, but also says Wolf Mountain is one of the steel towers made from surplus test towers, built 1981, and mentions 29-foot towers of a different type. The sources do not reconcile these. The story reports the disagreement without choosing one.

The brief flags a dispute over whether a tower, a building or only a tree stood here. NHLR resolves the early period as a crow's nest tree platform, followed by a wooden tower in 1926 and a later camp-style garage in 1934.

corrections.proposed: 1921 first lookout (crow's nest tree platform); 1926 wooden tower; present 108-foot timber tower built 1947
corrections.why: NHLR's text dates the present tower to 1947; the 1921 date refers to the earlier tree platform.

notes_for_editor: Height 32.9 m is converted from the register's 108 feet. The register also mentions 29-foot towers of another type, which we did not attempt to reconcile. Staffing as_of is 2015 because the register's staffing line is undated; the 2015 Cal Fire post is the newest dated item read. The Placer County lookout page returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Access level is not stated in any source, so none is recorded. Verification 2026-10-08: the 1947 date is now worded as the register's own account (materials stored until 1947, when manpower was available to build), not as a confirmed completion date; the climbing advice was removed because no source supports it.
